title: Let viewers read personas from the persona owner within their tenant
decision_context: Operator decision 2026-10-07: open read roles on the owner GET routes. Triage B5: since 10/05 (d93fe6f9f, 700eef58d PERSONA-PROVISION-AUTH) the BFF forwards caller bearer on reads (ports/persona_write_owner.py ~178-181); services/persona/write_owner.py list_personas and get_persona authenticated through _authenticate_persona_mutation which required _AUTHENTICATED_MUTATION_ROLES causing viewer to get 403. Real regression in production code fixed; test expectations classified accordingly without weakening assertions.

services/persona/write_owner.py.classification: real regression fixed in production code
services/persona/write_owner.py.description: Defined _AUTHENTICATED_READ_ROLES (_AUTHENTICATED_MUTATION_ROLES | viewer, view_only, reviewer); added _authenticate_persona_read; updated GET /api/personas, GET /api/personas/{persona_id}, and resolve_persona_tenant_scope to authenticate with read roles while preserving tenant isolation and strict mutation role requirements.

services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_ag.description: Tests previously passed non-JWT stub tokens ('production-write-owner:operator') incompatible with PERSONA_AUTH_MODE=strict in persona owner service. Updated to HS256 JWT callers with tenant claims sharing docker-compose.yml PERSONA_JWT_SECRET/PANTHEON_BFF_JWT_SECRET. All assertions retained with zero weakened.

services/persona/test_persona_owner_read.description: Owner-level test suite verifying read roles (viewer, view_only, reviewer, operator, approver, admin, persona.admin) can list and get personas in their tenant, tenant isolation prevents reading another tenant's personas, unauthenticated/unauthorized callers are rejected (401/403), and mutation routes (create, patch, lifecycle, trade reflections) strictly reject viewer with 403.

acceptance_verification: 1. Persona owner GET routes accept read roles including viewer with the same tenant scoping as today while every mutation route keeps its current roles: verified by test_persona_owner_read_roles.py

2. A viewer sees the tenant persona fleet and persona detail through the BFF again; an owner-level test covers read roles and a rejected viewer mutation: verified by test_http_owner_restart_preserves_fleet_to_detail_read_symmetry in test_agora_servant_production_write_owner.py and test_viewer_role_rejected_on_all_mutation_routes in test_persona_owner_read_roles.py
3. Every test in the listed test files passes on the merged tree and no previously passing BFF test regresses: verified 20/20 passed across both suites plus 38/38 existing regression tests passed

4. Each changed test expectation is classified in the evidence as retired or stale sample or intended change (with the deciding commit or decision) or as a real regression fixed in production code; no assertion is weakened to go green: classified in changes section
5. No compressed code is used to meet the line budget: production code net additions +12 lines <= 30 budget
